findings.current: The instant I avoided the five streams of finger force, the Taeeul Miri Palm struck me.
findings.defect: The translation renders 탄지공 as generic “finger force,” erasing its distinction from 지력 earlier in the scene and losing the established finger-flicking mechanism.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly calls the five streams 탄지공, whose binding glossary rendering is “finger-flicking technique”; “finger force” is used for the distinct term 지력 in line 265.
findings.replacement: The instant I avoided the five finger-flicking attacks, the Taeeul Miri Palm struck me.

summary: One minor terminology defect; otherwise faithful.
